payload.label: Cheapest premises licence application
payload.note: Band A covers premises with a rateable value up to £4,300. At the other end, a large venue used mainly for drinking on the premises pays £1,905. Norwich publishes and collects these amounts but does not set them: the levels come from national regulations made under the Licensing Act 2003, which the fees book itself does not spell out.
